      "observations": [
        "All 16 owned paths and every changed test hunk were read. The patch removes the synchronous spin loop around account removal, captures password URI/name before teardown, completes account/plugin/contact/preference teardown before starting asynchronous login removal, and removes obsolete no-op Account Manager rebuild calls.",
        "The accepted AccountsService and IM incoming-server bridge retain synchronous deletion/notification calls. imAccount.remove does not return or await _removePasswordInternal; account-removed therefore establishes account teardown, not completion of login-store deletion. The helper awaits searchLoginsAsync and removal of the first matching login. Its returned promise is not handled at this call site; no rejection or store-scheduling experiment was performed.",
        "The savePage guard skips an account absent from the account service before onSave and value collection. The actual selection caller still attempts to save the previous currentAccount, so this is a bounded deleted-account guard rather than a general ban on saving during UI selection.",
        "The server-order helper keeps the existing DOM children when sorted row identities already match, and restores selected only inside the replacement branch. The listbox change is a local comment typo correction, not a new focus contract.",
        "The new browser task directly checks created/removed account and login counts/values, tree rows/selection and pane URIs. All added assertions have nonempty expected-result messages with should. Helpers exercise wizard navigation and removal with two 100 ms delays; no direct assertion establishes absence of nested event loops, a specific focus state, or a Promise.resolve yield as a general login-removal completion guarantee. Existing surrounding assertions were not rewritten.",
        "The added microtask yields in the other 10 test files/shared head are cleanup scheduling steps, not new direct account-removal assertions. The accepted new browser test is byte-identical to the landing; broader changed production files have later edits and are represented only by exact bounded accepted windows.",
        "Complete primary 0–4/activity/footer was read from Parent’s exact retained original; the own review and nine actual submitted inlines were already read by C during collection. Both original collectors/read scopes/times remain unchanged. The earlier source-stage discussion requirement is now resolved.",
        "The reporter attributes the broken removal UI to asynchronous password-removal ordering. Actual source moves teardown before login-store work and adds the account-page existence guard and order-change-only DOM replacement requested/described in author inlines. The password consistency concern remains broader than this patch; the author explains shared login reuse for other account types and defers that work. No general security guarantee is inferred.",
        "The request for a removal test is reflected in the new browser task despite its Not Done badge. The optional JSDoc request is reflected in the two source summaries. The reviewer’s prospective waitForCondition concern is not adopted in the inspected test: it still uses final login/UI assertions and timed accept steps.",
        "Review reports include a selection failure later seen without the patch and a separate chaos-mode pane-URI failure. The primary later reports a timeout and null select exception. These historical failures remain unresolved here; their mechanism is not assigned to the static unreturned-promise finding, and landing with ongoing/failed builds does not prove a pass."
